intro: This quest marks a critical turn in the investigation of the sinister Cult of the Dark Strand, shifting the pursuit from the ruined Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore across the border to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier dispatches adventurers into nearby cultist camps to secure a potent Glowing Soul Gem. Unlocking this artifact reveals the grim sorcery that fuels the cult's influence over the northern forests.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.
Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you acquired that soul gem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
